chunks: Everything in this book that is from Saʿdān ibn Muslim, whose name is ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muslim, I have narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from al-ʿAbbās ibn Maʿrūf and Aḥmad ibn Isḥāq ibn Saʿd together, from Saʿdān ibn Muslim.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Indicates that both named narrators transmit together in the chain.
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: A transmission formula indicating the author’s own route of narration.
key_terms.وَ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُسْل: An identification note clarifying the narrator’s personal name.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Saʿdān ibn Muslim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits narrations from Saʿdān ibn Muslim, identifying him as ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muslim. Its significance lies in hadith documentation and the preservation of precise transmission routes in Shia scholarly tradition.
